title: Home practical guide and safety card: rice drum
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Sound (Misty Mountain, Sierra and How Can We Change a Sound?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 19 (Home practical guide and safety card: rice drum (portal worksheet; adult stretches cling film))
intro: Lesson 19: Volume: loud and quiet sounds. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out how the strength of a hit changes the volume
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: An adult stretches cling film tightly over the bowl
Sprinkle a few grains of rice on top
Tap gently near the drum with the spoon (or on the side of the bowl)
Watch how high the rice jumps
Record what happens to the rice and the volume

questions.q: Big question: what changes when you tap the tray harder?
questions.a: The vibrations get bigger, so the sound is louder.
